text: Une seule liste : ne correspond pas à mon usage
author: Dany Wonderland Riddick
developer_reply:
Thank you for trying Habit It and sharing your feedback. We’re sorry it doesn’t fully match your needs right now.

If you’d like to tell us more about how you use multiple lists, feel free to email us at support@thinkoutside.app. We’d love to consider your ideas for future updates!

Paul, co-founder of Habit It
